title: Basic Conditions of Employment Act 75 of 1997
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Basic Conditions of Employment Act 75 of 1997'. Commencement: 21 March 1998 for some sections and 1 December 1998 for the rest. It carries an amendments list and no [repealed] tag. Gazette PDF: /sites/default/files/gcis_document/201409/a75-97.pdf.
notes: Covers hours, payment of remuneration and deductions (Chapter 4) and the particulars of employment.
